detail: Presented in Kyiv on 24 August 2026, during events marking the 35th anniversary of the restoration of Ukraine's independence, 'as a token of gratitude for Latvia's significant support to Ukraine'. Kulbergs said he saw it as an honour for all of Latvia rather than for himself. Zelenskyy decorated the presidents of Estonia, Lithuania, Moldova and Finland, the President of the European Council and the prime ministers of the United Kingdom and Luxembourg on the same occasion.
